{{Quote|Not a word coming out of there. But if they were planning anything, they wouldn't tell CSF. Word is that Shevu is seriously hacked off with his way of doing business, too.|Gefal Keb discussing the Galactic Alliance Guard and Jacen Solo|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
The '''Galactic Alliance Department of Public Protection''' was the [[Office of the Chief of State|department]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] that supervised [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|domestic security]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The department received information from the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

[[Gefal Keb]], a [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], served as a senior [[Bureaucrat/Legends|civil servant]] within the department. He provided information to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] that the Coruscant Security Force had given him regarding [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Department of Public Protection first appeared in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published on [[May 29]], [[2007]].
